most_recent.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I'm very happy with my purchase. The quiet clicks are great, the mouse is comfortable, the scroll wheels are useful, and button placement is good.
most_recent.title: Great mouse!

most_recent.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This mouse feels better and sounds better than you could possibly imagine. Worth every penny.

most_recent.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Great mouse, I would just remove the device switch button from the bottom in somewhere on the top, so I don't need to raise the mouse each time. I would like the wheel scroll had a left/right button like HP.
most_recent.title: Great mouse but slow improvement between generations

most_recent.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This mouse is a huge step up from the little round one that hurt my wrist. It is comfortable, fits my hand perfectly, smooth on many different surfaces and feels really solid. Love it!!!
most_recent.title: Comfortable and smooth

most_recent.text: Very quiet clicking, probably the best part of the mouse. I'm still working on implementing the customizable buttons, but I think they'll be helpful. The Bluetooth can be a bit finnicky but that's probably on my system.
most_recent.title: Quiet and customizable

most_recent.text: The MX Master 3S & MX Keys were not allowed in our business due Security requirements. With the Business Edition with Logi Bolt we are allowed to use the best mouse and keyboard on the market. MX with Logi Bolt passes the most stringent security requirements.
most_recent.title: Security Issue

most_recent.text: The MX Master 3S doesn't disappoint when it comes to its great ergonomics for larger hand. With it's design, my hand fits comfortably on it and doesn't cramp up as often compared to other mouses. The magspeed wheel and multiple buttons also makes it so much more productive to work with when coding or other tasks where you can assign functions to them. The sleek design of the mouse is also a plus!
most_recent.title: Always comfortable and great for coding
